name: Capstone Project
description: The capstone project involves selecting a research problem related to materials science and engineering, performing experimental or computational work, analyzing results, and presenting findings. Topics include material synthesis, processing, characterization, thermodynamic/kinetic modeling, and failure analysis. The course emphasizes independent research, problem-solving, and technical communication.
